name: Freshsales Classic
description: Freshsales Classic is an online, cloud-based CRM with integrated phone and email, user behavior tracking, lead scoring and more.

events.d: Search accounts by name or a custom field and return matching records from Freshsales Classic.
Find contacts by email, name, or a custom field.
Create a new account and set name, phone, website, and additional account fields.

Create a new contact using an email (required) and optional details such as first and last name, phone, job title, lifecycle stage, tags, and other fields. Fails if a contact with the same email already exists.
Update an existing account by its name, modify phone, website, and other account fields. Requires a single matching account name.
Find a contact by email and update its details (name, phone, job title, lifecycle stage, tags, and selected custom fields).
Create a deal linked to an account and optionally a contact (creates the contact if missing). Set the deal stage, expected close date, and additional or custom fields.
Update a deal's details (amount, stage, probability, expected close date, contacts, and other custom fields) by deal ID or name.

events.n: When a new contact is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically when a new contact is added to your Freshsales Classic account.

events.n: When a new account is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new account is created in Freshsales Classic.

events.n: When a new deal is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new deal is created in the account.

events.n: When a new task is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new task is created in Freshsales Classic.
Get contacts from a selected view, optionally sorted.
Add a note to a Contact, Account, or Deal in Freshsales Classic by finding the record using email (Contact) or name (Account/Deal).
Create a new lead in Freshsales Classic. Requires an email and sets the contact's lifecycle stage to Lead; it won't create a record if a contact with the same email already exists.
Find an existing lead by email address.
Change a contact's lifecycle stage. Optionally update the contact status or lost reason.
Find a lead by email or ID and update its details (name, phone, job title, tags, and selected custom fields).
Runs when deal stage changes
Find a deal by ID, or find deals by a specific field value (exact match).
Retrieve notes for a deal
Create or update a Freshsales Classic contact by contact ID or email.
Add a note to a contact in Freshsales Classic using the contact's ID or email.
Delete multiple deals by entering IDs or searching by deal name.
List deals from a selected view, optionally sorted (defaults to descending).
